dataList.content:
You see, I called you this time, because...
这次把大家叫来，是因为……
dataList.place:
Blossoming League of Nine Littérateurs
绽放的九人会

dataList.content:
I've made something interesting that I'd like to show.
我想展示我所制作的一些有趣东西。

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Ahem...
咳咳……

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Young-ji... What is this?
灵之……这是什么？

There are simply too many transient things that wilt all too soon, don't you think?
世上有太多转瞬即逝而顷刻谢幕的事物，不是吗？

The butterfly only wanted to lightly flutter, but to be punished with death for that crime... That felt too unfortunate.
蝴蝶只是想轻轻飞翔，却因这样的罪过而永远告别人生……实在非常遗憾。

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Did you... bring it back... from the dead? I thought that kind of technology was forbidden by the Head's treaty...
难道说……你是把死去的东西……给复活了吗？这种技术是被首脑明令禁止的……

It is no such case. Although the carcass remains inanimate, something has overridden it.
不。尸体并没有改变，但有别的东西覆盖上去了。

That's right. To be exact... it's the glass window.
没错，更准确地说……是玻璃窗。

The butterfly can now be free within it.
在窗内，蝴蝶终于获得了自由。

Even if its wings dampen while trying to cross a pond, are gripped in somebody's hands and crumble to dust, or dry out due to the lack of flowers...
即使因想要飞过池塘而沾湿了翅膀，即使被人捉住碾成粉末，即使找不到花朵而陷入干渴……

The butterfly won't stop. And eventually... in the distant future...
蝴蝶也不会停息。终于……在遥远的未来……

It'll make it across a sea.
它将跨越大海。

If that happens, will the butterfly no longer be afraid of the sea?
那样的话，蝴蝶是不是就不会再害怕大海了？

dataList.content:
Splendid, Young-ji. This level of technology could have numerous applications.
太棒了，灵之。这种等级的技术拥有无穷无尽的用途。

dataList.content:
Young-ji... Are you sure... you really made this just for the conference?
灵之……这项技术……你真的只是为了朗术会才研发的吗？

What do you mean by that?
你是什么意思？

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs

dataList.content:
A gathering where we show technology we've created as a hobby in our free time after returning from a day's work, sharing our thoughts...
一个我们结束一天工作后，在空余时间互相展示因爱好而发明的技术，并分享各自想法的集会……

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs

dataList.content:
Wasn't that the significance and appeal of the illuminators' conference our League had?
这不就是我们九人会开展朗术会的意义和浪漫所在吗？

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs

dataList.content:
But this... It doesn't look like a simple hobbyhorse to me.
但这项技术……似乎不仅是出于兴趣爱好才做出来的？

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs

dataList.content:
Are you still... not over what happened then...
你不会还……因为当时那件事……

...That's... how you see it, Dongbaek...
……冬柏……你原来是这样想的啊……

I'd like to know what you think as well, Yi Sang.
我也很好奇你的见解，李箱。

As Dongrang rightfully assessed, this is nothing short of a great first discovery.
正如东朗所言，这无疑是一个伟大的新发现。

Alas...
但是……

If frost were to form on the glass window...
如果玻璃窗上结了霜……

It will blur the reflected image all the same.
反映的物体也同样会变得模糊。

As such, the frame of this glass window... will need to be made firmer and straighter.
因此，这扇玻璃窗的窗棂……需要造得更结实、更端正。

Yi Sang, you managed to see through its essence from just a single glance.
李箱，你一眼就洞穿了它的本质。

But personally... I can't seem to think of a way, so how about this instead?
但就我个人而言……没法做到。所以，不如这样呢？

Yi Sang, try recreating it in your own way.
李箱，就用你的方法重新创造它。

My own way...
我的方法……

That's right. By the next conference.
没错。在下次朗术会上。

Is it... truly okay for me... to handle a technology as valuable as the glass window?
让我……负责像玻璃窗这样的珍贵技术……真的可以吗？

You got it wrong. I'm making this suggestion because it's valuable.
你理解错了。我提出这个方案就是因为它十分珍贵。
